label: Generate 3D Model
description: Create a 3D mesh from a text prompt and/or a reference image using any 3D generation endpoint.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.description: Description of the object to create.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Reference Image
inputs.description: Concept image to build the model from (asset, path or data URI).

inputs.name: params
inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.description: Extra parameters as a JSON object, merged over the node's own parameters.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model Override
inputs.description: Overrides the configured model endpoint at runtime.

outputs.name: path
outputs.label: File Path
outputs.description: Local path of the mesh file.

outputs.name: url
outputs.label: URL
outputs.description: URL the mesh is served from inside the Suite.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Error message if the step failed. Wire it to handle failures yourself; leave it unwired and the node fails visibly instead.

properties.label: Prompt
properties.placeholder: Used when nothing is wired into Prompt
